title: PITCH semi-final: was it set for Wednesday 17:00 or for Thursday?
summary: One summary relayed to us has the semi-final on Wednesday 17:00, with no source; a press preview of 9 November puts the semi-finals and the final on Thursday. If it was always Thursday, the closure may not move it. The full agenda is behind a login.
closes: A Web Summit page (the agenda, the PITCH page or a blog post) that gives the slot.

sides.held_by: social.watch@'s summary of 21:53, no source given (evidence, unsourced)

history.change: card opened from timeline row s-1110T2153 and the decision graph's conflict note on pitch-semifinal
open → answered: answered by a primary source: timeline row s-1111T0255 (Web Summit's session page, read 02:55:56 by the team). The press preview that put it on Thursday was wrong on this

answer.text: Web Summit's own session page for the PITCH semi-final, read 02:55:56 UTC on 11 November, gives it as 11 November 2026, 5.00PM to 6.00PM, Centre Stage: the original slot was Wednesday 17:00, not Thursday.
answer.label: fact
